explication: Agent Plugins for AWS package reusable expertise for AI coding agents: skills guide workflows, MCP servers expose live services, hooks automate guardrails, and references supply supporting knowledge. The documented user journey is to install a plugin, invoke a relevant capability while architecting, deploying, or operating on AWS, and review the generated result. Sampled code shows concrete DSQL query-safety, deployment-diagram processing, and SageMaker data/model workflows. Most plugin workflows are documented but their implementation files are not present in the supplied tree; edges therefore reflect only README statements or visible calls.
